simple.meaning: שָׁמֵן (shâmên) is a Hebrew object word meaning “greasy , i.e. gross ; figuratively, rich.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 49:20. The surrounding context includes kingship, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁמֵן (H8082) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: שָׁמֵן (shâmên) / H8082 is traced through Genesis 49:20, Numbers 13:20, Judges 3:29, 1 Chronicles 4:40 with generated occurrence evidence.

timeline.evidenceText: and what the land is, whether it is fertile or poor, whether there is wood therein, or not. Be courageous, and bring some of the fruit of the land.” Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.
They struck at that time about ten thousand men of Moab, every strong man and every man of valor. No man escaped.
They found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceful; for those who lived there before were descended from Ham.

They took fortified cities and a rich land, and possessed houses full of all good things, cisterns dug out, vineyards, olive groves, and fruit trees in abundance. So they ate, were filled, became fat, and delighted themselves in your great goodness.
For they have not served you in their kingdom, and in your great goodness that you gave them, and in the large and rich land which you gave before them. They didn’t turn from their wicked works.
He will give the rain for your seed, with which you will sow the ground; and bread of the increase of the ground will be rich and plentiful. In that day, your livestock will feed in large pastures.
I will feed them with good pasture; and their fold will be on the mountains of the height of Israel. There they will lie down in a good fold. They will feed on fat pasture on the mountains of Israel.

“I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick; but I will destroy the fat and the strong. I will feed them in justice.” ’
Therefore he sacrifices to his net, and burns incense to his dragnet, because by them his life is luxurious, and his food is good.

definitions.full: H8082. shamen שָׁמֵן adjective fat, robust ; — ׳שׁ masculine Judg 3:29 +, feminine שְׁנֵנָה Gen 49:20 +; — 1 fat, rich , of food, Gen 49:20 (poem in J), Isa 30:23 (+ דָּשֵׁן ), Hab 1:16 (||); of land, festile Num 13:20 (E), Neh 9:25 , 35 , pasturage Ezek 34:14 ; 1Chr 4:40 . ( 1Sam 15:9 see מִשְׁנֶה 3 ). 2 stout, robust , of men Judg 3:29 (|| חַיִל אִישׁ ; see GFM); feminine collective (figurative of flock) Ezek 34:16 (+ הַחֲזְקָהִ ).
